about: Batch 2 review viewpoints (docs/waves/BATCH2_SPEC.md §2.8), generated from data/expansion.json: per new venue a street view (eye 5.5 st above the terrain) and, for enterable venues, an inside view at floor + 5.2; district aerials. Same conventions as views.json (pos/look in studs; aboveGround per view). Render with: python -I tools/review/render.py --scene build/review/scene.json --views tools/review/views_batch2.json --set batch2 --out build/review/batch2 [--only name,...]. The venues appear once their build/Expansion_F*.rbxm are added to the review scene (group "attractions", tools/review/attractions_export.luau).
